central-florida.label: Central Florida
atmosphere: Warm humid air creates constant atmospheric softness and gentle environmental diffusion.
Light transitions remain smooth and moisture-softened rather than sharply directional.
Humidity subtly reduces environmental clarity and contrast at distance.
Morning and evening scenes may contain low drifting mist above water surfaces.
Air should feel dense, warm, calm, and quietly alive.

midwest-farm.label: Midwest Farm
atmosphere: Open air with softer atmospheric humidity than Florida and less cold density than Pacific Northwest.

Air should feel calm, spacious, seasonal, and quietly familiar.

pacific-northwest.label: Pacific Northwest

appalachian-creek.label: Appalachian Creek
